title: test(verify): pay the first boot load at collection and share one boot per configuration in two harness suites
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-project-manager"} -->
_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1XVdKSKTiX7AWsYagk2P8mJT)_
Part of #23181 (slice 9). The card stays open for its other rows.

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

Test files only, so this PR carries `skip-changeset`: both files are `*.test.ts` under `packages/verify/src`, which the package's build does not ship.

## What changed

Two `@objectstack/verify` harness suites booted a fresh in-process stack in every case and paid the boot's first load inside the first case's clock.

- `src/harness.app-default-profile.test.ts`: `await warmUpBoot()` at module scope (`boot-warm-up.testkit.ts`, the convention slices 3 and 4 used). The first two cases now read ONE boot of the declared-default configuration from a `beforeAll`. The first reads the profile the boot wired; the second signs a member up and reads as them. Neither reads what the other writes. Boots: 4 → 3.
- `src/harness.org-context.test.ts`: `await warmUpBoot()` at module scope. One `beforeAll` boots `app` with the flag off, records what the cases read, and stops. Then it boots with `orgContext: true`, records, and stops, in the same order the ruling case always booted them. The ruling case compares the two recorded postures, the bind case reads the `orgContext: true` boot, and the default-boot case reads the default boot. Boots: 4 → 2.

Every assertion reads the same value of the same boot shape (same configuration, same options) as before. The test full names are identical before and after (sorted `fullName` lists compared).

## The reading, and the rows this PR brings under 10 s

The reading is refresh PR #25960's per-file list (runs `40200279306` and others in its window). The newest LANDED refresh, #25409, lists no per-file rows; slice 8's report records why. Of this family, #25960 still lists five rows:

| file | #25960 slowest (runs over / executed) | local before → after, median of 3 | this PR |
|:--|--:|--:|:--|
| `src/harness.app-default-profile.test.ts` | 18.90 s (1 / 2) | 6608 → 3126 ms (×0.47) | **under 10 s**: projected 8.9 s in CI |
| `src/harness.org-context.test.ts` | 16.60 s (1 / 2) | 6741 → 2431 ms (×0.36) | **under 10 s**: projected 6.0 s in CI |
| `src/harness.key-custody.test.ts` | 22.41 s (2 / 2) | 6852–7338 ms, untouched | open: see Acceptance notes |
| `src/harness.one-composition.test.ts` | 17.89 s (2 / 2) | 9206–10354 ms, untouched | open: see Acceptance notes |
| `src/handle.test.ts` | 17.30 s (1 / 2) | 3857–4253 ms, untouched | open: already warmed, one shared boot |

The pin is the next landed refresh: it should no longer name the two rows marked under 10 s.

## Measurement

On one 4-vCPU box, under `os-verify-lock`. It is a shared box, so the ratios carry the result rather than the absolute times. Each run is one `vitest run --maxWorkers=2` process per file. The number is the default reporter's file line (the module's duration: hooks included, collection excluded), which is the figure the timing refresh reads. The json reporter's `endTime - startTime` leaves out a `beforeAll` that runs before the first case, so it is not used. BASE `a6e8f95d6` copies and HEAD files were interleaved A/B in the same lock hold.

| run | app-default BASE | app-default HEAD | org-context BASE | org-context HEAD |
|--:|--:|--:|--:|--:|
| 1 | 6488 | 3126 | 6523 | 2431 |
| 2 | 7591 | 3523 | 6741 | 2702 |
| 3 | 6608 | 3023 | 7223 | 2263 |

**Cases still isolated.** `vitest run --sequence.shuffle --sequence.seed=N` over both files, seeds 1 to 5: 11 / 11 passed each time. With seed 1, the member sign-up case ran before the profile read on the shared boot. With seed 2, the default-boot case ran before the ruling case.

**Where a boot's time goes.** A CPU profile of six warm `bootStack` calls (0.82–1.09 s each) puts the largest share in the default datasource's schema sync on sql.js (`knex` `ensureConnection` / `query` → `driver-sqlite-wasm` `_query`, `driver-sql` `initObjects`). A test file can only boot fewer times; it cannot make a boot cheaper.

## Acceptance notes

- `harness.key-custody.test.ts` (22.41 s, 2 / 2) is untouched. Each of its 5 boots runs under its own key posture, so no two boots can be shared. A warm-up is excluded there by slice 4's seat ruling (option A on `6221027193`): it would build the harness data key outside the keyless posture the file inspects.
- `harness.one-composition.test.ts` (17.89 s, 2 / 2) is untouched. It is already warmed. Each of its 12 boots is the subject of its case (the instance rule and composition), so no two can be shared. It reads 9.2–10.4 s locally.
- `handle.test.ts` (17.30 s, 1 of 2 runs over) is untouched. It is already warmed and boots once per file. The one reading over 10 s came from the window's most loaded run (`40200279306`, where all five rows took their slowest).
- `#23181` remains open for those rows and for the other packages' rows.

## Tests

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/verify typecheck`: VERDICT command-exit 0 (`check:test-typecheck: OK`, 0 debt).
- `eslint --no-inline-config packages/verify`: exit 0.
- Both files: 11 / 11 passed in 6 A/B runs and 5 shuffled runs.
- `@objectstack/verify` whole suite (`vitest run --maxWorkers=2`): Test Files 46 passed (46), Tests 393 passed (393), VERDICT command-exit 0.
- Gates at `cb29c5b4d`: `dispatch-gates --commands` derived 55 commands, and all 55 exit 0. `--ran` reports "55 derived, 55 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN" and exits 0. On the first pass two gates exited 3 with PREREQUISITE NOT MET, which is not a verdict: `check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test` (shallow clone; fixed by fetching `621a4876`) and `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` (eight packages had no `dist/`; fixed by building them). Both exit 0 on the re-run.
